paragraphs.text: Check-in desks at Warsaw Chopin Airport are numbered 101–150 in zones A (101–118) and B (121–150), and 201–280 in zones C (201–230), D (231–250) and E (251–280).
Passengers travelling with LOT Polish Airlines may use the common check-in area for all flights except charter services.

Modernisation of the security screening areas is under way. The airport says longer queues and temporary closures of individual Fast Track areas may occur during the works, but at least one Fast Track area will remain available at all times.

According to the airport, Warsaw Public Transport serves the airport with buses and SKM trains. The airport gives the travel time to the CENTRUM stop as approx. 30 minutes and advises buying at least a 75-minute ticket.

The airport has an underground railway station close to the terminal. The airport lists the S2 (towards Sulejówek Miłosna), the S3 (towards Legionowo) and the RL (towards Modlin) as departing from it.

The airport lists bus 175 towards Pl. Piłsudskiego as operating daily, bus 331 towards Metro Wilanowska as operating Monday to Friday during peak hours, and the night line N32 towards Centrum as operating daily.
The airport gives the taxi fare from the airport to the city centre as approx. 50 PLN. Uber self-service kiosks (Tap to Ride) are in the baggage reclaim hall and the arrivals hall.

Coaches use a bus terminal in front of the south pier on the arrivals level, close to the exit from the railway station. It has 21 bus stands, and stands 1-16 are reserved for scheduled connections. Flixbus is among the operators the airport lists.

The airport says it offers over 3,000 parking spaces in barrier-controlled car parks (Valet Parking, Express, P2, Komfort, P3 and P4) as well as metered car parks, and 89 spaces in the short-stay Kiss & Fly zone.

The airport's price list, which shows no date of validity and is the price on the airport's page on 5 October 2026 (check it before you travel), gives Express as PLN 15 for up to 30 minutes, PLN 30 for each additional hour or part thereof and PLN 350 for 24 hours. Parking at Express is available for up to 24 hours from the time of entry.

On the same price list, Komfort is PLN 40 for up to 1 hour and PLN 310 for 1 day, and Valet Parking is PLN 280 for 1 day. The airport says these rates apply to payments at the car park cash desks, and that online booking fees depend on parking occupancy.

In the Kiss & Fly zone, parking is free for up to 7 minutes, up to 3 times per day; the price list gives PLN 40 for 7 - 15 minutes. A Komfort ticket entitles one person to use the Fast Track security lane.

PRM assistance at Warsaw Chopin Airport is free of charge. The airport asks you to notify your carrier or tour operator when booking or buying your ticket, no later than 48 hours before departure; without that notice it will still provide assistance, but waiting may be longer.

If you are already at the airport, you can ask at the SOS pillars (four in the departures area and one in the terminal–railway station connector), at the airport information desks in departures zones AB and D and arrivals zone AB, or at your flight's check-in counters. Staff aim to assist within 10 minutes for passengers who gave notice at least 48 hours ahead.

Passengers with reduced mobility can have the free stay in the Kiss & Fly zone extended up to 20 minutes by telling the intercom when taking the entry ticket. Hidden Disabilities Sunflower lanyards are free at the information desks on the Departures level in zones AB and D.

The airport runs three pay-in Executive Lounges: Fantazja, Preludium and Etiuda. Fantazja is in the Schengen zone near gates 37-36 on level 1 and opens daily from 5:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. Preludium is in the Schengen zone near gates 34-35 on level 0 and opens 5:00 a.m – 10:00 p.m.
Etiuda is in the non-Schengen zone near gates 1N–4N on level 0 and opens daily from 6:30 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. Entry to each lounge is possible up to 3 hours before departure.

The airport lists a single entry at 210 PLN and a 12-month annual pass at 230 PLN online; its page shows no date for these prices, so they are the prices on 5 October 2026 and should be checked. You can also buy a single-entry ticket at any lounge reception (cash or card), or at one of two card-only kiosks in the departures hall next to the Fast Track entrances.

faqs.q: How much is the taxi from Warsaw Chopin Airport to the city centre?
faqs.a: The airport gives the taxi fare to the city centre as approx. 50 PLN. Uber self-service kiosks are in the baggage reclaim hall and the arrivals hall.

faqs.q: How long does public transport take from Chopin Airport to central Warsaw?
faqs.a: The airport gives the travel time to the CENTRUM stop as approx. 30 minutes and advises buying at least a 75-minute ticket.

faqs.q: Is PRM assistance at Warsaw Chopin Airport free?
faqs.a: Yes. The airport says the service is free of charge and asks you to notify your carrier or tour operator no later than 48 hours before departure.

faqs.q: How much is Express parking at Chopin Airport?
faqs.a: On the airport's price list as read on 5 October 2026, Express costs PLN 15 for up to 30 minutes, PLN 30 for each additional hour or part thereof and PLN 350 for 24 hours. Check the current list before you travel.

faqs.q: Which Executive Lounge is in the non-Schengen zone?
faqs.a: Etiuda, near gates 1N–4N on level 0, open daily from 6:30 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. Fantazja and Preludium are in the Schengen zone.

faqs.q: How long is free parking in the Kiss & Fly zone?
faqs.a: Free parking is available for up to 7 minutes, up to 3 times per day, according to the airport.
